affinity-app.title: Texas Affinity - Affinity APP
affinity-app.summary: Built a CRM application for an insurance company with React, Laravel and MariaDB, featuring a data import feature that significantly enhanced overall productivity.
affinity-app.description: Built a CRM application for an insurance company with React, Laravel and MariaDB. The application included a data import feature that significantly enhanced overall productivity by reducing to 0% the necessity of sending informative emails.
achievements: Successfully developed a comprehensive CRM solution for an insurance company
Implemented a data import feature that eliminated the need for informative emails
Enhanced overall productivity through streamlined data management processes

cpfl.title: [Python/React/Django] ML/AI Integration System
cpfl.summary: Led the modernization of regulatory processes for an energy utility, leveraging machine learning and a robust data pipeline to optimize maintenance workflows and issue detection.
cpfl.description: Led the modernization of regulatory processes for an energy utility, leveraging machine learning and a robust data pipeline to optimize maintenance workflows and issue detection. The solution, built with React, Django, and PostgreSQL, using Websockets and BroadcastChannel API, integrated seamlessly with machine learning algorithms through REST APIs, providing real-time insights and interactive visualizations for end users.
achievements: Designed and implemented a React front-end to present maintenance workflows and machine learning outputs
Developed Django back-end features to facilitate real-time communication with machine learning services
Configured and optimized PostgreSQL for efficient data storage and retrieval
Implemented robust error handling and API management to enhance system reliability
Created dynamic data visualizations for interpreting machine learning insights

eletra.title: [React/TypeScript/Python/Django] Wind Turbine Blade Wear Prediction System
eletra.summary: Contributed to the maintenance, bug fixing, and deployment of a high-security software system for a wind turbine blade wear prediction project in the hydroelectric industry.
eletra.description: Contributed to the maintenance, bug fixing, and deployment of a high-security software system for a wind turbine blade wear prediction project in the hydroelectric industry. Operated in an offline, tightly controlled environment, deploying updates for both the React front-end and Django back-end. Ensured the system functioned seamlessly in both development and production environments on an IIS server, overcoming restrictions such as the lack of direct internet access.
achievements: Diagnosed and resolved critical bugs, maintaining a stable and reliable codebase for production use
Deployed front-end and back-end artifacts to a secure IIS server, adhering to stringent security protocols
Utilized Django APScheduler to ensure scheduled tasks operated reliably in both environments
Coordinated secure artifact transfers, performing integrity checks for successful deployment
Introduced incremental enhancements to the React front-end for improved usability

informativoir.title: [React/TypeScript/Python/Django] Texas Seguros - informativoir.com.br
informativoir.summary: Designed a CRM with Django, DRF (Django REST Framework), React, and PostgreSQL, saving the company $5 million annually and resolving complex historical data issues.
informativoir.description: Designed a CRM with Django, DRF (Django REST Framework), React, and PostgreSQL, saving the company $5 million annually. Resolved a complex historical data issue for a contract with SulAmerica, the 2nd largest Brazilian insurance company with more than 7+ million users. Engineered system modules including users, plans, taxes, and dental, ensuring data integrity and reducing processing time by 40%. Optimized database queries to reduce time of requests by 50%, and developed algorithms to calculate income tax statements.
achievements: Designed a CRM solution that saved the company $5 million annually
Resolved complex historical data issues for a contract with SulAmerica (7+ million users)
Engineered system modules ensuring data integrity and reducing processing time by 40%
Optimized database queries to reduce request time by 50%

power meter.title: [React Native/TypeScript] Ictus Power Meter
power meter.summary: Developed a cross-platform mobile application for professional cyclists to interface with a Bluetooth-enabled power meter device, leveraging AWS services for secure data storage and processing.
power meter.description: Developed a cross-platform mobile application for professional cyclists to interface with a Bluetooth-enabled power meter device. Built with React Native, the app provided real-time power metrics and performance insights, leveraging AWS services for secure data storage and processing. Successfully deployed to both the Google Play Store and Apple App Store, delivering a seamless experience for end users.
achievements: Designed and implemented a React Native mobile interface for real-time cycling power metrics
Integrated AWS services including S3, DynamoDB, Lambda, and API Gateway for data management
Successfully deployed the app to both Play Store and App Store with compliance to platform requirements
Collaborated with firmware engineers to ensure seamless Bluetooth communication
Optimized app performance, reducing latency and improving responsiveness under varying network conditions

sae.title: [Vue.js/TypeScript/Spring Boot] Wi-SUN Network Simulation Tool
sae.summary: Developed a comprehensive simulation tool for Wi-SUN network devices, designed to help users visualize device locations and network topology on an interactive map.
sae.description: Developed a comprehensive simulation tool for Wi-SUN network devices, designed to help users visualize device locations and network topology on an interactive map. The project combined a robust Vue.js front-end with Leaflet for mapping, and a Spring Boot back-end with OracleDB for data management and simulations.
achievements: Designed and implemented a Vue.js front-end integrated with Leaflet for real-time visualization
Built and maintained Spring Boot microservices for CRUD operations and network simulation logic
Integrated OracleDB to securely store device configurations and simulation parameters
Enhanced user authentication mechanisms and implemented basic security measures
Improved team workflows by introducing and maintaining Swagger documentation

sod noronha celpe.title: [Python/Django] Dispatch Optimization System
sod noronha celpe.summary: Developed and maintained the web interface for communication with the Dispatch Optimization System (SOD) used at the substation on Fernando de Noronha Island.
sod noronha celpe.description: Developed and maintained the web interface for communication with the Dispatch Optimization System (SOD) used at the substation on Fernando de Noronha Island. The web system, built with Django, was designed to integrate with external APIs and simulate data from diesel generators using a proprietary program, ActionView. The project required precise execution in a remote environment with limited internet connectivity and communication.
achievements: Updated and maintained the Django codebase for seamless communication with external APIs
Integrated and maintained MATLAB scripts for periodic job execution using Django APScheduler
Authored a detailed deployment manual for system implementation in challenging remote environments
Executed deployment and system tests on-site, ensuring 100% functionality despite limited internet
Conducted rigorous testing to validate system stability and accuracy of data exchange
